regime_notes: No new ecosystem or asset crossed the framework alert threshold after the prior CLARITY Act risk-off observation. Broad weakness remains dominated by macro/regulatory risk ahead of the September 16 Federal Reserve decision rather than a clean new discretionary-capital migration.

Global on-chain activity is mixed rather than capitulatory: DEX velocity remains elevated on Solana and Base, while Sui DEX/perp activity contracts and Hyperliquid spot/stablecoin capital stock has softened even as perp fees and volume remain economically large.

Solana tokenized-equity headline volume remains quality-contaminated by StonkFun's stock-paired meme-launch model and substantial ecosystem rewards. This contamination was already identified in prior research, so it does not constitute a new RAY/STONK entry signal despite real Raydium settlement and fee generation.

The September 15 rsETH loss used an authorized custom Safe/Uniswap-v4 liquidity module with faulty authorization and an attacker-controlled hook. Available technical reporting does not identify Uniswap v4 core or the official StablePair hook as the failure mode, so UNI's structural gate remains pass with composability-risk caveats.

HYPE remains the largest existing-position risk: Multicoin-linked Coinbase Prime deposits and Bitwise-related transfers continue to signal possible distribution, but no new evidence establishes aggregate exchange net inflows or a collapse in protocol fees/revenue. The previously alerted risk therefore remains HOLD rather than TRIM.

ZEC continues to hold near its paper basis better than most risk assets, but no third independent selective accumulation path or fresh usage acceleration was verified; relative strength alone does not justify an add.

Portfolio NAV is approximately $9,641.75 versus $9,685.00 for the frozen passive benchmark, trailing by about $43.25 or 44.65 bps. No hard structural gate failed and no position meets the persistent thesis-failure condition for a trim or exit.
